notes: Lumen: a faceted crystal core in a dark navy frame with 1px cyan edge lines. The on loop rotates the light round the 8 facets (two facets per frame). Damaged: a crack runs through the crystal, one facet is chipped dark, the upper-right accumulator has lost its crystal, edge lines flicker. Disabled: the crystal is dull and fractured with a missing facet, shards on the frame, every edge line dead.
